description: This is a PHP source file for a stand-alone script that performs a silent upgrade of a SuiteCRM instance. It includes utility functions for configuration checks, manages upgrade processes, handles log setup, performs database repairs, rebuilds relationships, and cleans up post-upgrade. The script is designed to be run from the command line with specific parameters, automating the upgrade process without user interaction.

classes.name: RepairAndClear
classes.description: A class used to perform database repair and cache clearing operations during the upgrade process.

methods.name: checkConfigForPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the config.php file exists and adds default permissions if not set.

methods.name: checkLoggerSettings
methods.description: Ensures logger settings are configured in config.php.

methods.name: checkResourceSettings
methods.description: Ensures resource management settings exist in config.php.

methods.name: verifyArguments
methods.description: Validates command-line arguments for correctness and required parameters.

methods.name: rebuildRelations
methods.description: Rebuilds relationships between modules, used during upgrade.
